invariants.rationale: writeClient is dereferenced, so must be non-null for method safety.
instantTime is used in downstream method calls and should not be null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed to writeClient.bulkInsertPreppedRecords and must be non-null.
writeClient is typed as BaseHoodieWriteClient, so this should always hold.
Elements of preppedRecordInputs are used as HoodieRecords; if non-empty, first element must be a HoodieRecord.
